velocity: Mean of predicted component among integrated points in each position/time bin; bins with fewer than 5 points masked
paths: Actual midpoint-integrated trajectories of the trained 2D field, projected onto x or y
density: Counts divided by total sample count and bin width; no per-time normalization
projection_note: Horizontal position reflected to align with clockwise-rotated MIG; M at top, I at center, G at bottom. Letter bases face the incoming flow.
